## Essay use

Primary technical source for demonstrations, ranked outputs, reward modelling, and reinforcement learning from human feedback in InstructGPT. It grounds the actual pipeline before the essay interprets preference geometry and delegated normativity.

**Claim boundary:** use the paper for what the system does and how it is evaluated. Subjectivity and the metaphysical nature of meaning require separate evidence and argument.
